# LFG Traditions - civics.

# Pampered Masters: a "reverse Rogue Servitor". An individualist, biological empire whose robots serve the organics.
# Organics live in comfort (and work less); robots are rare, expensive and carefully licensed.
# Cybernetic and synthetic ascension are blocked mid-game by the overrides in
# common/ascension_perks/zz_lfg_ascension_path_overrides.txt (generated by tools/gen_overrides.py).
civic_lfg_pampered_masters = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/governments/civics/civic_machine_servitor.dds"
	modification = no
	potential = {
		ethics = { NOT = { value = ethic_gestalt_consciousness } }
		species_archetype = {
			NOR = {
				text = civic_tooltip_lfg_not_machine_or_synthetic
				value = MACHINE
				value = ROBOT
			}
		}
	}
	possible = {
		ethics = {
			NOT = { value = ethic_fanatic_spiritualist }
		}
		origin = {
			NOR = {
				text = civic_tooltip_lfg_not_robotic_origin
				value = origin_cybernetic_creed
				value = origin_synthetic_fertility
				value = origin_mechanists
				value = origin_unplugged
			}
		}
		civics = {
			NOR = {
				value = civic_augmentation_bazaars
				value = civic_permanent_employment
			}
		}
	}
	random_weight = {
		base = @civic_rare_random_weight
	}
	description = civic_tooltip_lfg_pampered_masters_effects
	negative_description = civic_tooltip_lfg_pampered_masters_negative_effects
	modifier = {
		# Upsides: comfortable organics, hard-working robots
		biological_pop_happiness = 0.10
		pop_amenities_usage_organic_mult = -0.20
		robotic_pop_bonus_workforce_mult = 0.20
		pop_servant_bonus_workforce_mult = 0.25
		# Strong downsides: lazy masters, few and costly robots, demanding workers
		organic_pop_bonus_workforce_mult = -0.20
		planet_pop_assembly_mult = -0.40
		job_roboticist_max_workforce_mult = -0.25
		planet_pop_assemblers_alloys_upkeep_add = 1
		pop_category_workers_consumer_goods_upkeep_add = 0.1
	}
}
